correctness.rationale: PASS: Construct exactly 20 ordinary Mycielski graph edges and all 967 nonempty matching faces (f0..f4=20,135,365,360,87). Reconstructed the 466-pair successive-edge-toggle discrete Morse matching and global DAG acyclicity; remaining critical cells: one 0-cell, five 2-cells and twenty-nine 3-cells. Independently constructed signed integral Morse boundary from matched-face eliminations and computed Smith invariant factors [1,1,1,1,1] for the 5x29 matrix, proving primitive surjection and vanishing attached 2-spheres. This plus pi2(wedge five S2)=Z5 yields wedge 24 S3; field ranks alone would not suffice. Source minor determinant -1 refers to tuple-lex ordered critical cells whereas independent code uses integer-mask critical-cell order; Smith factors are basis-invariant.

originality.rationale: PASS best-of-knowledge: The previously published results on matching complexes of paths/cycles/star-clusters (Donovan–Scoville), outerplanar graphs (Bayer–Jelić Milutinović–Vega), and claw-free independence connectivity (Engström) neither contain the Mycielski Grötzsch matching complex nor determine its integral homotopy type. Ind(Mycielski graph) is not matching complex Ind(line graph of Mycielski graph). Resultary search yielded own record and other graph instances, not an implication-equivalent theorem. The finite result has unavoidable risk of an unindexed graph topology table.
